feature: Canonical saved company profile during opening recovery
basis: Original Bookr publication recovery and metadata contracts. This is a consistency correction to existing saved-result behavior, not an inferred reference configuration rule.

study.existingBehavior: The metadata endpoint trims saved strings. Creation can succeed before selecting/opening the new company fails. Existing recovery retains the saved UUID, disables fields and retries opening without another POST.
study.reproducedGap: Creation retained raw draft strings and an unbound target heading while showing a successfully saved, disabled result. Unlike alteration, it did not bind the canonical response to the form.
study.boundary: Headless original Bookr fixtures only; no native or reference-source actions. Pending State Escape and new accounting/configuration rules are excluded.

behavior.publication: After a successful create or alter response, display returned saved metadata, target heading, UUID and revision before follow-up reads or activation.
behavior.reuse: One original form-binding component is shared by creation and alteration. It must not change controller mode or select a company.
behavior.controls: Preserve existing DOM nodes, disabled states, immutable date controls and focus. Refresh the existing country calling-code display through its normal input notification.
behavior.dates: Do not copy ISO date properties into formatted date inputs. Keep the existing validated creation/alteration calendar behavior.
behavior.recovery: Keep published fields disabled, show Open Company, and retry the saved UUID. Never repeat the POST or treat a saved result as a dirty draft.

keys.Escape or Back: Leave the saved result without unsaved confirmation; explicit later selection opens the same UUID

behavior.restore: Retain existing restore behavior; no new file-format, tax, security or currency rules.

accountingEffect: None. Existing company rows, vouchers, postings, bill allocations and 60000-paise outstanding remain unchanged.

browserCommands.execution: One complete chain after the unit suite

verificationResult.promotedSource: Six new binding unit tests, four creation/restore recovery cases and eleven alteration groups passed serially on the actual source
verificationResult.previewAudit: Four API-bound read-only screenshots, zero attempted writes or page errors; saved data, source and browser session retained
verificationResult.screenshots: Saved-result fields, target heading, formatted dates and retry control reviewed; no native pixel-equality claim
verificationResult.pending: State suggestions and unverified company-configuration behavior remain outside this fix

verification.redFirst: Add meaningful unit checks for canonical metadata binding, disabled/date-control preservation, identity and text safety before the shared binder exists; reproduce raw creation fields in the existing publication browser before changing product code.
verification.browser: Whitespace metadata, actual saved profile, failed selection, disabled canonical form, one POST, GET-only retry, safe Back, exact session rollback and financial preservation; retain alter and restore regression checks.
verification.order: Focused RED then code/GREEN; full unit/HTTP suite then complete browser chain serially; read-only preview audit; one-feature commit and study archive.
verification.protectedPorts: Never access 4315. Preview 4780 is read-only and must not be reset or reseeded.
